resources.string: Sign in with Microsoft
Offline, Ely.by and Microsoft accounts
Microsoft account

Offline and Ely.by accounts work in single player, on LAN and on servers with Ely.by or offline mode. For official servers and Realms, sign in with Microsoft: you need a purchased copy of Minecraft: Java Edition.
Sign in with Microsoft
Getting a sign-in code…
Open the Microsoft page and enter this code:
Copy code
Code copied
Open microsoft.com/link
Waiting for confirmation in the browser…
You enter your password only on the Microsoft website; the launcher never sees it. The session is kept in Windows Credential Manager.
Try again
Sign-in was cancelled in the Microsoft window.
The code has expired. Press “Try again” to get a new one.
This Microsoft account has no Xbox profile. Create one on xbox.com and try again.
This is a child account: an adult in the Microsoft family group has to allow sign-in.
Xbox Live is not available in this account's country.
Minecraft: Java Edition is not purchased on this account.
Mojang has not approved Microsoft sign-in for this launcher build yet. Meanwhile you can play with an offline or Ely.by account.
